title: Per-customer golden-sample sampling + dynamic thresholds for A/B/Shadow auto-quarantine
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduce a per-customer golden-sample sampling layer combined with dynamic, workload-aware thresholds to gate canary, A/B and shadow traffic. Goals: reduce false positives from global thresholds, catch targeted regressions for high-value tenants, and enable automated soft-quarantine (throttled traffic diversion + auto-notify) before full rollback. This ticket implements sampling, scoring, and a small-state orchestration layer that integrates with existing rollout conductor and eval scorecards.
acceptance_criteria: Per-customer golden sampling: for any customer with >100 monthly requests, system stores/maintains a 200-example golden reservoir sampled across their recent traffic and canonical eval prompts
Dynamic thresholds: scorecard thresholds adapt based on customer's baseline variance (rolling 30d) and can be bounded by global minima/maxima
Integration: rollout conductor can read per-customer gates and apply soft-quarantine (route 20% of traffic to baseline model and 80% to candidate) automatically when gate trips

Automation: when quarantine continues for >3 hours or error delta > configured hysteresis, system auto-creates rollback flag and an incident ticket (with top 5 failing golden prompts), and notifies SRE/PM on-call
Observability: dashboards show per-customer golden coverage, score deltas, quarantine events, and time-to-rollback; test dashboard seeded with synthetic customer to validate behavior
Test harness: unit + integration tests covering sampling, threshold calculation, quarantine orchestration, and rollback flagging (CI gated)
No regression in baseline canary latency (<= +5ms p50) when gate checks are enabled for 10k rps
Security review completed for storing per-customer golden prompts (KMS, ACLs)
technical_notes: Data model: store per-customer golden reservoir as time-windowed KV entries keyed by customer-id with hashed prompt ids to avoid PII; metadata contains source (eval/prod-sampled), last-scored timestamp, and score history
Sampling policy: hybrid strategy - deterministic selection for canonical prompts + probabilistic reservoir sampling for live traffic up to 200 examples; evict oldest low-variance examples first

Threshold algorithm: compute weighted z-score across a small metric vector (rouge-like similarity, semantic embedding distance, task-specific heuristics). Use Bayesian shrinkage to blend customer baseline with global prior to avoid overfitting on small customers
Orchestration: extend rollout-conductor API with /gates/customer/{id} endpoint returning gate state and recommended action {pass, soft-quarantine-percent, escalate}

Quarantine: implement soft-quarantine by instructing router to mirror X% of traffic to baseline and attach quarantine tag; maintain sampling to ensure golden prompts are preferentially routed into the mirrored stream
Rollback: flag persists for 12h by default; automatic rollback only after quorum of signals (score delta > thresh AND top-5 prompt failures > 3) to reduce flapping
Storage & security: encrypted-at-rest via customer KMS where possible; access-controlled service principals for eval service; audit logs emitted for all golden operations

Performance: gate checks should be cache-backed (TTL 30s) with async refresh to avoid adding tail latency to requests; heavy scoring runs executed in background batch jobs and used to update gate state
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): implement data model, sampling, and offline threshold export; run against synthetic workloads for validation
Phase 2 (canary customers): enable per-customer gates for 5 low-risk customers (opt-in); monitor dashboards and collect feedback for 2 weeks
Phase 3 (soft-quarantine): enable automated soft-quarantine for customers with >1M tokens/month; refine hysteresis and percent-throttle defaults
Phase 4 (auto-rollback): enable auto-rollback for customers who opt-in to autonomous rollbacks; keep manual approval for enterprise customers by default
Phase 5 (global): enable default per-customer gates for all customers above threshold and add UI in Console for customers to view/override their gate settings
metrics: per-customer_score_delta: detect mean delta > 0.15 compared to baseline
false_positive_rate: target < 5% for quarantine triggers after 4 weeks of data
time_to_quarantine: median < 5 minutes from gate trip to router enforcement
time_to_rollback: if auto-enabled, median < 20 minutes after quorum of signals
latency_overhead: P50 added by gate checks <= 5ms at 10k rps
